text:
maya: Heads up — planning rollout for 'adaptive cutover' (feature: tenant-priority routing + regional fallbacks). Need alignment on canary slices, A/B for quality, and kill-chain.

sam: Thx. What's the customer ask? Which tenants need opt-in vs auto?

maya: Two big asks: (1) Enterprise customers want per-tenant opt-out + SLA carveouts. (2) Growth wants a soft-default for 5% of new users in NA to test latency/cost impact.

diego: Propose phased plan: shadow -> micro-canary (0.5%) -> small cohort (5%) -> regional ramp. Each stage gated by: Errors < 0.5%, latency p95 delta < +30ms, cost per 1k tokens uplift < 10%.

alyssa: We need telemetry hooks — add a 'cutover' dashboard with these metrics + sample prompt testset pass rate. Also add regression alert for quality when embedding-sim drops > 3%.

raj: Flag model: `feature.adaptive_cutover_v1` + subflags per tenant `feature.adaptive_cutover_v1.{tenant_id}`. Kill switch = `feature.adaptive_cutover_v1.force_off`.

chris: Can we do an A/B where B uses KV-cache prewarm and lower quantization? That helps isolate cost vs quality.

maya: Yes. A/B plan: A = baseline model; B = quantized+prewarm. Run 1 week on 5% NA. Tracking generation quality, refund-rate proxies, and infra cost.

sam: Who owns rollout ops? Need on-call and rollback script. cc @eng-oncall

eng-oncall: Assigned: oncall@eng-oncall for the window 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-08. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cutover

diego: Add auto-fallback policy: if p50 latency > 300ms or error rate spikes >0.7% for 10m, route to fallback model (smaller variant) and notify #incidents.

alyssa: QA: build small prompt set for each customer class (SaaS, Search, Chat). We'll need baselines.

maya: Action items: 1) Product: finalize cohort list (maya) 2) Eng: flag + fallback (raj/diego) 3) DevEx: dashboard + prompt-set (alyssa) 4) Oncall: rollback script + monitors (sam). Target preflight window: 2026-04-01 shadowing.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll set up the runbook and test the rollback in staging tomorrow.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in weekly rollout sync Friday 9am PT.
